//: Schema migration + demo seed, as a one-shot. Apply with: northflank create job --project beff -f deploy/northflank/job-migrate.json
//why-a-job: Migrations and serving are different concerns with different failure modes. A failed migration should stop the deploy with a readable error, not put the API into a crash loop — and this is also the shape that survives more than one API replica, where N containers racing to migrate on boot is a genuine hazard. Same reasoning as the compose `migrate` service.
//schema-warning: A JOB nests the repo under `deployment.vcs` and the stage under `buildConfiguration.dockerfileTarget`. A SERVICE uses top-level `vcsData` and `buildSettings.dockerfile.dockerfileTarget`. They are NOT interchangeable: passing the service shape here does not error — the API silently reinterprets `vcsData` as the Dockerfile paths and the job is created with no repository at all.
//target: The ONLY resource built from the `migrate` stage, which extends `prod` by adding alembic.ini and migrations/. So this image can rewrite the schema and the one serving traffic cannot.
//command: Left as the image's CMD: `alembic upgrade head && python -m beff.seed`. The && is load-bearing — a failed upgrade must not be followed by a seed against a half-built schema.
//idempotency: Verified locally by running it twice against the same database: the second run is an alembic no-op and the seed upserts. Northflank re-runs this on every deploy, so that is not optional.
name: beff-migrate
description: alembic upgrade head, then seed the demo account.
